It took me a moment to understand your meaning, but yes, there appears to be some issue with the documentation deployment.

It is odd that index page (https://api.cslib.io/docs/) exists but any individual modules give a 404. Just to rule out it being something transient with GitHub, I've set the last build of the docs to rerun.
When will the website be back online?
I'm not really sure what the issue is. Rerunning the CI for the docs didn't work because GitHub doesn't allow publishing twice on the same commit apparently.
This seems to be fixed now after another docs deployment. I'll chalk it up to GitHub flakiness.
Sorry, I didn’t see this topic before. I believe I fixed this last week. The workflow is fired in the same repo of the website
